description: `activity broadcast` (hub-only — HUB_PROJECT_NAME is the literal string 'multiverse', not configurable) leaves one message in every project [activity.pairs] permits and reports a partial fan-out rather than refusing outright: a permitted leaf is marked 'sent', a leaf the hub cannot message is marked 'skipped — not permitted by [activity.pairs]', and the totals line counts both. Pure file I/O — no herdr call anywhere on this path.
